unit: Unit 13: Making Your Computer Easier to Use
title: Making text bigger
drDigitalIntro:
The fastest fix for small print is to make all the text bigger at once.
• Text Size lives in Settings, under Accessibility.
• Drag the slider right and every menu, label and message grows together.
• This is different from zooming a single web page — this changes the whole computer.
• Common mistake: nudging it up by one step and deciding it did not work. Push it well past halfway and look again.

playgroundTask.goal: You made every label on the computer bigger

steps.say: Click Accessibility in the list on the left.
Drag the Text Size slider until it reads between 125 and 140.

drDigitalSuccess: Look at the menu on the left — every word grew with it.
drDigitalHint: Accessibility is the third item in the left-hand list. The Text Size slider is the first control inside it.
